newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Canton CSD, N.Y.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Canton Central School District,
(St. Lawrence County),
New York
General Obligation School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997
(Book-Entry-Only) (Callable) (Bank Qualified)

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received and considered by the President of the Board of Education of the Canton Central School District, St. Lawrence County, New York at the offices of Roosevelt & Cross, Inc., 20 Exchange Place, New York, New York 10005, until 12:00 Noon, Prevailing Time, on
Wednesday, June 4, 1997
at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the
purchase INFEDERALFUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $2,150,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, (the Bonds''
), maturing on J h year as
follows:
MATURITIES
The Bonds will be dated June 15, 1997 and will bear interest payable semi-annually on June 15 and December 15 of each year commencing December 15, 1997.

The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds maturing on or after June 15, 2006 are subject to redemption at the option of the School District in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale.
The School District will designate the Bonds as qualified tax-exempt obligations'' pursuant to Section (b)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended.

The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as securities depository for the Bonds. The School District will be furnished the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of St. John & Curtin, L.L.C., Rochester, New York, on or about June 17, 1997.
The School District reserves the right to change the time and/or date for the opening of bids. Notice of any such
change shall be provided not less than 24 hours prior t time set forth above for the opening of bids by means of a supplemental notice of sale to be transmitted over The Munifacts Wire.
Requests for copies of the Notice of Sale herein

summarized and the Official Statement relating to the Bonds and such other information as the State Comptroller may prescribe by rule or order may be directed to Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., Suite 112, P.O. Box 1429, Cicero, New York 13039; Phone (315) 699-7912, Fax (315) 699- 8833. Additional Official Statements may be downloaded from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc.'s Internet address:
http://www.fiscaladvisors.com.
Dated: May 23, 1997 Floyd E. Morter, Jr
Canton, New York President, Board of
Education
(From The Bond Buyer)
